post.summary: Preview information before signing up for a new membership
post.description: Required Scopes: `MEMBERSHIP_WRITE`

400.description:
The membership signup preview could not be created.

Known error codes:

- `errormessage.validation.notnull` - a required property of `contract`, `customer`, or nested data is missing.
- `errormessage.validation.phone` - a customer or legal representative phone number is invalid.
- `errormessage.parameter.invalid` - a required legal representative person field is blank.
- `errormessage.validation.caused.errors` - a legal representative is incomplete or `customer.language.languageCode` is not a valid ISO locale.
- `invalid.request` - the request body is missing, malformed, or contains an invalid date, country, enum, or ID format.
- `commons.error.duplicate.third.party.id` - `customer.thirdPartyId` is already assigned.
- `commons.error.duplicate` - an existing customer matches the studio's duplicate check or `contract.thirdPartyId` is already assigned.
- `errormessage.validation.taxid` - the tax ID is invalid or required by the studio's country rules.
- `errormessage.validation.identity.number` - `customer.documentIdentification` is invalid.
- `errormessage.customer.invalid.email` - `customer.email` is invalid.
- `errormessage.dateofbirth.in.future` - `customer.dateOfBirth` is in the future.
- `errormessage.customer.age.invalid` - `customer.dateOfBirth` results in an age outside the supported range of 0 to 100 years.
- `errormessage.entity.system.message.category.not.found` - a category in `customer.communicationPreferences` is not configured.
- `errormessage.feature.set.create.member` - the studio's rate plan does not allow another customer to be created.
- `errormessage.rate.bundle.online.rejected` - `customer.dateOfBirth` does not meet the studio's minimum age for online contracts (`HNMA`).
- `errormessage.benefit.minimum.age.not.reached` - the customer is too young for the selected offer's age restriction.
- `errormessage.contract.start.date.is.too.old` - `contract.startDate` is earlier than permitted.
- `errormessage.preuse.not.allowed` - `contract.preuseDate` requests pre-use on an offer that does not allow it.
- `errormessage.contract.start.date.of.use.invalid` - `contract.preuseDate` is after `contract.startDate`.
- `errormessage.contract.start.date.of.use.past` - `contract.preuseDate` is in the past.
- `errormessage.rate.bundle.expired` - the selected offer is no longer available.
- `errormessage.rate.bundle.term.not.found` - the selected offer is not available in the studio's active Open API offer group.
- `errormessage.rate.bundle.selected.modules.invalid` - `contract.selectedSelectableModuleIds` exceeds the offer's selection limit.

Use `errorCode` for programmatic handling. Validation errors can include `reference`; business errors do not.
The human-readable `errorMessage` may be localized. An invalid voucher is reported in a successful preview's `voucherErrorCode`, not as a 400 response.

post.summary: Change a membership contract due date
post.description:
Required Scopes: `MEMBERSHIP_SELF_SERVICE_DUE_DATE_WRITE`

Validates and applies the due-date change, then returns the resulting charges and payment schedule. For monthly and yearly payment frequencies, targetDueDay accepts 1 through 31. The apply date is the first matching date strictly after today in the contract's studio time zone, using the last day of a shorter month while retaining the requested due day. For example, a request on February 2 in a non-leap year with targetDueDay=29 takes effect on February 28. If the adjusted date is today or has passed, the corresponding date in the next month is used. The due date of a pro-rata charge is the current date.

The due-date change could not be previewed or applied.

- `errormessage.validation.notnull` - the required `targetDueDay` request property is missing.
- `invalid.request` - the request body is malformed or contains a value in an invalid format.

- `errormessage.validation.min` - `targetDueDay` is less than 1.
- `errormessage.validation.max` - `targetDueDay` exceeds 7 for weekly frequencies or 31 for monthly and yearly frequencies.
- `errormessage.open.api.due.date.change.payment.frequency.not.supported` - the contract does not use a supported recurring payment frequency.
- `errormessage.open.api.due.date.change.same.due.day` - `targetDueDay` is already the contract's due day.
- `errormessage.contract.adjustment.same.apply.date` - another contract adjustment is already scheduled for the calculated apply date.
- `errormessage.open.api.due.date.change.contract.terminated` - the contract is canceled, reversed, or ends before the calculated apply date.
- `errormessage.open.api.due.date.change.contract.frozen` - the contract is frozen on the calculated apply date.

x-enumDescriptions.WRITE_OFF_REMAINING_DEBTS: Indicates to the studio that all remaining, unpaid debts should be written off. ClosureUpdate.description: Must be set in case the case has been closed

type.description: Closure type

x-enumDescriptions.POSITIVE: This should be used, if mostly all or all open debts are paid. A positive closure reverses the dunning level of a customer, if all other debt collection cases are also closed. Closure parameters i.e. write off remaining claims will result into writing of all open claims of this debt collection case.
x-enumDescriptions.REJECTION: This should be used, if the agency does not accept the case. The rejectionReason must be set in this case. It ignores all other closure parameters and will reopen the claims.
x-enumDescriptions.NEGATIVE: This should be used, if none debt is paid or no chance of further collection. A negative closure reverses the dunning level of a customer, if all other debt collection cases are also closed and no claim is open anymore. It will not reverse the dunning level in all other cases. Closure parameters i.e. write off remaining claims will result into writing of all open claims of this debt collection case.
x-enumDescriptions.REVERSAL: This should be used, if there was already progress on the case and no rejection reason can be taken. It ignores all other closure parameters and will reopen the claims.

rejectionReason.description: Mandatory if type is REJECTION. This defines why the case was rejected by the agency.

x-enumDescriptions.CLAIMS_TIME_BARRED_OR_RESIDUAL_DEBT_DISC: The claim is no longer enforceable (plea of limitation raised or discharge of residual debt granted).
x-enumDescriptions.NO_INFORMATION_ABOUT_LEGAL_REPRESENTATIV: The claims in the file are directed against minors, unless another personally liable person (e.g. the parents) is known to Magicline Studio and can be claimed against.
x-enumDescriptions.FRAUD: The obligation was unlawfully entered into by an unknown third party on behalf of the alleged debtor (in particular, deception by a third party as to the identity of the debtor). Evidence within the meaning of this Agreement shall be deemed to have been provided if: (1) real data of third party users have been used to obtain services or (2) the invoice recipient has not become a contractual partner or (3) criminal charges have been filed by Magicline Studio.
x-enumDescriptions.MISSING_COMPENSATION_BLOCKING_DUNNING_PR: The claim depends on a consideration and prevents the execution of the judicial dunning procedure (BGB 688 para. 2 ZPO).
x-enumDescriptions.NO_PROCESSING_AT_ALL: If the file is withdrawn or cancelled from the collection stage within 14 days after handover without being processed by the contractual partner. The contractual partner shall be released from any obligation to pay remuneration. After 14 days, the file can be withdrawn only for one of the other reasons.
x-enumDescriptions.NOTIFICATION_OBLIGATIONS_NOT_POSSIBLE: The statutory information and notification obligations, in particular from Section 13a RDG, cannot be fulfilled.
x-enumDescriptions.WITHDRAWN_BY_STUDIO: There are other comprehensible reasons on the part of the Contractual Partner and/or Magicline Studio.
x-enumDescriptions.CLAIM_INCREASE_IMPORTED_CASE: Claim increase on file from old system (ES; ugly; etc).
x-enumDescriptions.HARD_NEGATIVES_IN_DEBTOR_REGISTER: There are already hard negatives in the debtor register and a court order would be unsuccessful.
x-enumDescriptions.NO_COLLECTION_ABROAD_POSSIBLE: The claim concerns a debtor living abroad, unless the collection of the claim can be made from Germany.
x-enumDescriptions.COLLECTING_FROM_INHERIT_NOT_POSSIBLE: The claim is directed against an unknown heir who cannot be readily identified by inquiry at the probate court and civil status register.
x-enumDescriptions.REMAINING_CLAIM_BELOW_LIMIT: The (residual) principal claim does not exceed EUR 10.
x-enumDescriptions.CONFLICT_OF_INTEREST: There is a conflict of interest that cannot be resolved with the contractual partner or the lawyers to be commissioned by the contractual partner.
x-enumDescriptions.CLAIMS_ALREADY_IN_COURT: A legal dispute is already pending regarding the claim, in which Magicline Studio is not represented by the contract partner's joint attorneys.
x-enumDescriptions.POSTAL_DELIVERY_NOT_POSSIBLE: No postal delivery can be made on the basis of the membership data provided, and an address search is also unsuccessful.
